row: Treasured Animal Rescue is a foster based organization dedicated to saving homeless and abused animals. Our rescue is run by volunteers.  We rescue over 200 animals with 30 dedicated foster homes. Most dogs and cats are pulled from kill shelters. TAR was founded in 2017
